description:
Cast Goldvein Hydra by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Goldvein Hydra, adding {C}{C}.
When Goldvein Hydra dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Goldvein Hydra from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goldvein Hydra trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
